question.text: A radioactive isotope having a half - life period of 3 days was received after 12 days. If $3 \mathrm{~g}$ of the isotope is left in the container, what would be the initial mass of the isotope?

solution.text:
Given $t_{1 / 2}=3$ Total time $\mathrm{T}=12$

No. of half lives $(n)=\frac{12}{3}=4$ $\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{n}=\frac{\mathrm{N}}{\mathrm{N}_{\mathrm{o}}} 

\therefore\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^{4}=\frac{3}{\mathrm{~N}}$

$\frac{3}{\mathrm{~N}}=\frac{1}{16}$

$N=48$
